findings.desc: packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:847 story_advance is configured for post-command milestone_status append, but DONE cleanup removes the story worktree before the append hook reads milestone-ledger.json, so story_advance --phase=DONE can succeed without printing Milestone Status. Render before cleanup or read the durable main-root store after DONE, and add a DONE regression.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 7a407d4d by falling back to the captured main root for milestone_status rendering after story_advance DONE removes the story worktree, with a runCli regression proving DONE stdout still contains Milestone Status after cleanup.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/milestone-status.ts:940 Pending Review semantics are not honored: fully covered ledger rows with ledger=planned render as ✅ Done because row.status is already completed before rowAppearsPendingReview runs. This conflicts with docs/CLI.md, which says covered or implementation-complete rows awaiting ledger/review/final acceptance should render 🟡 Pending Review.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 911497f by making fully covered ledger=planned or ledger=covered rows render 🟡 Pending Review while ledger=done remains ✅ Done, with milestone-status marker fixture coverage proving the planned+covered row behavior.

findings.desc: .lattice/story/actives/B-e62e/summary.json still says the observed milestone table had M1 and M2 with Done status, but the current renderer correctly emits 🟡 Pending Review for both rows while ledger=planned and checklist/evidence are covered. Update the summary artifact so the closeout transcript matches current milestone_status semantics.
